summary: Flutter now matches the web viewer's explicit first-frame loading state instead of showing an unexplained black canvas while the selected video track has not rendered a frame. The state resets when the selected track changes, and first-frame events are logged without participant identities. This improves parity and separates a pending renderer from a rendered black source, but it does not prove or fix the reported Mac black-screen runtime.

checks.name: First-frame gate widget regression
checks.observation: The waiting state is visible before a frame, disappears when the renderer reports its first frame, and returns when the selected track generation changes.

checks.name: Changed-file Flutter analysis
checks.observation: No issues found in the three changed Dart files.

remaining: On a live Mac receiver, verify that the waiting state clears on a decoded/rendered remote frame, reappears on a new selected track, and correlates with receiver decoded FPS while comparing the same active Pixel publication in browser and macOS. Keep FE-61 open until live playback and unpublish behavior pass.
